entries.claim_boundary: This exact LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC/REDUCED-MODE result proves that the intrinsic global K3 class vanishes in the complete homogeneous-correction quotient for one balanced fixture. For the certified no-homogeneous-addition second-order representative, every occupied original shell has a nonzero bounded adjoint functional, while a finite exponential-polynomial third-order preimage exists with secular terms. The bounded shell quotient over arbitrary second-order homogeneous additions, causal inversion, all-orders integration, particles, positivity, unitarity and quantum theory remain open.

dispersion.statement: The sixteen-point third-order frequency lattice and its four original-shell coincidences are exact.

lee_wald.statement: The shell adjoints use the action-normalized reduced axial Hessian and its certified Lee-Wald pairing.

resonance.statement: Local-in-time shell resonance is a separate cokernel and correction-class question.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: The declared balanced tangent has the imported finite second-order correction.

causal_retarded.statement: No retarded compact-product correction complex is supplied.

smooth_secular.statement: The same second-order correction belongs to the finite exponential-polynomial module and is in fact finite quasiperiodic.

taub_maps.statement: K3=0 in O/im(l2), with im(l2)=span{H,J1,J2} and quotient basis {P_x,J3}.

scope.boundaries: closed S1_L x S2; global compact-stabilizer constraint quotient
scope.carrier: balanced real axial Einstein-minus plus second extra-primary ell=2 tangent with its certified polar second-order correction
scope.charge_sector: fixed magnetic bundle N=2 and fixed electric charge; no homogeneous Wilson-line shift
scope.ell: third-order closure ell=2,4,6; projected original ell=2 shells
